jobs.title: Marketing Associate, Events & Community
jobs.excerpt:
Why AssemblyAI 
 AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. 
 We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $500K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. 
 If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. 
 We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator to join our San Francisco Office. This is a high-execution, broad-scope role for someone who is organized and ambitious, loves being in the room when things happen, and finds genuine satisfaction in making complex logistics look effortless. You’ll be responsible for field marketing, community, campaign execution, and light office coordination. This is a role for someone who wants to become a strong marketing operator: the kind of person who can take a clear direction and turn it into reliable, organized action. 
 Why This Role Exists 
 We've opened a San Francisco office to strengthen our presence in the Voice AI market by expanding our field marketing programs. Sponsoring (and building campaigns around) third-party events, crafting executive dinners and experiences, and hosting community meetups are core to how we build relationships and awareness in our market — and these programs are growth channels, not just gatherings: they fill pipeline, activate developers on our products, and feed our launches. 
 We've reached the point where we need dedicated execution support on the ground in SF to run more of these programs — and to connect each one to the campaign work around it: the emails that fill the room, the follow-up that converts attendees, and the reporting that tells us what worked. 
 This role is a force multiplier for the marketing team. It frees up capacity to run a higher volume of events, grow our local community presence, and add execution support across campaigns, lifecycle, and growth programs. 
 What You'll Do 
 Community & Event Support 
 
 Support email campaign execution—including list coordination, QA, asset organization, and execution follow-through  
 Contribute to recurring campaign workflows that keep marketing programs running smoothly and consistently  
 Assist with campaign setup and tracking across event, lifecycle, community, and brand work  
 Learn marketing tools like Iterable (or similar) and contribute to process improvement over time 
 
 Campaigns & Growth Marketing 
 
 Support email campaign execution—including list coordination, QA, asset organization, and execution follow-through  for emails like events, Newsletters, and product launches 
 Contribute to recurring campaign workflows that keep marketing programs running smoothly and consistently  
 Assist with campaign setup and tracking across event, lifecycle, community, and brand work  
 Learn marketing tools like Iterable (or similar) and contribute to process improvement over time 
 Build simple post-event and post-campaign recaps so the team knows what worked and what to run back 
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 
 Work with field marketing, growth, lifecycle, community, and brand teammates to keep projects moving 
 Bring structure and follow-through to ambiguous situations—flag blockers, close loops, keep stakeholders informed 
 Operate comfortably in an environment where priorities move quickly and clear direction matters 
 
 Must-Have Qualifications 
 
 1–3 years of experience in a marketing, events, or operations role (internships and contract work count) 
 Strong organizational skills—you track tasks, details, and timelines without dropping things 
 Clear, confident written and verbal communication; you can coordinate across multiple stakeholders without friction 
 Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities 
 Based in San Francisco; comfortable being in-person regularly 
 Fluent with AI tools in your day-to-day work—you use them to work faster and smarter, not as a crutch 
 Proactive communicator who flags issues early and closes the loop without being asked 
 
 Nice-to-Have Qualifications 
 
 Experience supporting events, field marketing, or community programs 
 Familiarity with tools like Iterable, Luma, looker 
 Experience at a startup or high-growth tech company 
 Exposure to email marketing operations, campaign coordination, or lifecycle programs 
 Background in community coordination, developer events, or brand activations 
 Experience in AI/ML, voice tech, or developer-facing products (a genuine plus, not a requirement) 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 30 Days 
 
 You understand the portfolio of events, campaigns, and programs we run 
 You’ve taken ownership of at least one active event or logistics initiative and are driving it forward 
 You’re oriented in our key tools and have a clear read on where you can add the most immediate value 
 You’ve started learning the details of our product marketing and positioning  
 
 60 Days 
 
 You’re operating with minimal oversight on logistics for multiple ancillary or third-party events—timelines, vendor comms, shipping, and materials run through you 
 You’ve executed at least one SF-based event or meetup and gathered learnings for the next one 
 You’re contributing to campaign execution support and have started learning our email and lifecycle tools 
 
 90 Days 
 
 You're a reliable, trusted operator for field marketing and campaign execution 
 You've identified at least one process gap and proposed an improvement 
 You're building real relationships with vendors, venues, and community contacts in San Francisco 
 You can report on a program end-to-end: what it cost, who showed up, and what happened after

jobs.title: Associate Field Marketing Manager (US East and Canada)
jobs.excerpt:
Datadog is looking for a resourceful and creative  Associate Field Marketing Manager to lead event strategy and execution for Datadog's AI product line across the East and Canada region. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about AI and developer communities, enjoys getting hands-on with technical audiences, and wants to build a market-leading brand presence for Datadog's AI offerings. 
 As part of the NAMER Field Marketing team, you will own the strategy, planning, and execution of a mix of practitioner-focused events, hands-on workshops, and surround activations at major AI conferences. This role is critical to scaling awareness and adoption of Datadog's AI products, and to building durable relationships with AI customers, prospects, and the broader developer community. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What You'll Do 
 
 Own the strategy, planning, and end-to-end execution of AI practitioner events, hands-on workshops, and meetups across the East and Canada 
 Lead surround and off-site activations at major AI conferences (e.g., NVIDIA GTC, Ray Summit, AI Engineer Summit, and similar industry events) to build brand visibility and drive engagement with target audiences 
 Partner with Product Marketing and AI/ML product teams to translate Datadog's AI observability and LLM monitoring capabilities into compelling, technically credible event content 
 Design and continuously improve hands-on workshop curriculum and live demos that showcase Datadog's AI products to practitioners and technical decision-makers 
 Build scalable, repeatable event playbooks and toolkits so programs can be run consistently across multiple markets 
 Manage vendors, venues, budgets, staffing, and on-site logistics, ensuring every event reflects Datadog's brand and delivers a seamless attendee experience 
 Partner closely with Sales and Field Marketing to align event strategy with territory and pipeline priorities across NAMER 
 Track, measure, and report on pipeline influence, attendee engagement, and program ROI, using data to continuously refine the event mix 
 Cultivate and grow relationships with AI developer communities, meetup organizers, and local user groups to expand Datadog's reach and reputation 
 Stay current on the AI/ML landscape and competitive events calendar to identify new opportunities for Datadog to show up and stand out 
 
 Who You Are 
 
 1-2 years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or program management, ideally with technical, developer, or AI/ML audiences 
 Genuine enthusiasm for AI and machine learning, with the curiosity to go deep enough on the product to speak to it credibly at events 
 Experience planning and running practitioner-focused events or hands-on workshops, from concept through post-event follow-up 
 Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events, vendors, and budgets simultaneously in a fast-paced environment 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable presenting to and engaging with technical audiences 
 A collaborative, cross-functional operator who partners naturally with Sales, Product Marketing, and Product teams 
 Process-oriented mindset with an interest in building scalable, repeatable programs 
 Familiarity with marketing or sales tools (e.g., SFDC, Marketo) is a plus 
 Ability to travel up to 50% of the time 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 
 Benefits & Growth: 
 
 Generous and competitive benefits package 
 New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan 
 Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
 Employee-focused best in class onboarding 
 Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program 
 Friendly and inclusive workplace culture 
 
 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. 
 #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $71,000 — $94,000 USD 
 About Datadog:  
 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

You will be responsible for defining product requirements, driving tooling enhancements, streamlining and simplifying process workflows, and managing project timelines and deliverables. jobs.title: Brand Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years. 
 What we do 
 The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! Role overview 
 The Brand Marketing Specialist will be responsible for leading all digital brand media campaigns across the US, Canada, and the UK. This role will shape digital investment strategies and own the creative lifecycle from brief to execution. Operating at the intersection of creative development and media strategy, this role will manage agency partners, track campaign performance, and oversee budgets to drive continuous optimization. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Work directly with the Brand Marketing Manager to determine our digital channel mix and investment strategy (e.g. Online Video, YouTube, Meta, TikTok). 
 Own the creative testing roadmap; partner with performance marketing and analytics teams to identify opportunities and structure testing plans. 
 Oversee the development of brand creative to fuel the digital media plan: 
 
 Draft creative briefs that are rooted in our brand story, customer insights, channel best practices, and campaign learnings.  
 Project-manage internal creative teams and external agencies, managing feedback, securing approvals, and trafficking final assets to media partners. 
 Maintain the brand team’s asset library and proactively identify opportunities to leverage assets and messaging across the organization. 
 
 Partner with analytics and engineering teams to advance digital brand measurement capabilities and translate creative learnings into actionable optimization strategies. 
 Monitor industry trends and identify emerging opportunities to drive continuous channel testing and expansion to drive performance improvements. 
 Generate and present monthly reports for mid-funnel channels across all active regions (US, CA, UK). 
 Responsible for budget planning and reconciliation for all mid-funnel digital brand channels. 
 
 What you'll bring 
 
 2+ years of professional marketing experience, preferably in consumer brand or performance marketing 
 Deep understanding of creative strategy and production, with a proven ability to connect creative insights directly to performance metrics and business outcomes. 
 Strong creative instincts with the ability to give clear, actionable direction and feedback to agencies and creative partners. 
 A data-driven approach to decision-making, with a focus on balancing long-term brand building with short-term conversions. 
 Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a track record of building cross-functional relationships and presenting to stakeholders. 
 Strong organizational skills and personal accountability, with experience managing budgets, project timelines, and competing priorities effectively. 
 Familiarity with leveraging generative AI tools to optimize creative workflows, speed up production, or streamline daily marketing tasks. 
 
   The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles. Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Position Pay Range $70,000 — $87,000 USD Working at CarGurus 
 We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. 
 We welcome all 
 CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.excerpt:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Derivative Sales Analyst on the Institutional team, you'll own and grow relationships with Coinbase's top prosumer derivatives traders, driving volume across futures, options, and perpetuals. You'll source new high-value traders from competitor venues, re-engage dormant accounts, and bring structured market and client insights back to Product, Risk, and Marketing to shape Coinbase's advanced trading offerings. 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Own and grow relationships with top prosumer derivatives traders on Coinbase, driving increased trading volume, deepening engagement, and expanding adoption of advanced trading products. 
 Source and convert new high-value derivatives traders from competitor venues through targeted outbound, differentiated positioning of Coinbase's liquidity, fees, and UX, and full-funnel sales management. 
 Monitor derivatives market structure, client flows, and competitor offerings to identify upsell opportunities, inform pricing and product feedback, and deliver structured insights to Product, Risk, and Marketing. 
 Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast for your book, reporting on key KPIs (volume, active traders, winbacks, competitor migration) and documenting client interactions through CRM tooling. 
 Reactivate previously dormant top traders using data-driven account reviews, tailored outreach, and bespoke incentives to restore sustained volume. 
 
 Required Skills and Experience: 
 
 2+ years of sales or business development experience in financial services, trading, or crypto, with a track record of hitting or exceeding revenue and volume targets. 
 Strong understanding of derivatives products (futures, options, perps, margin) in traditional finance or crypto markets, including how active traders use them in practice. 
 Data-driven operating style with experience using dashboards, CRMs, and basic analytics to segment books, identify opportunities, and prioritize outreach. 
 Background in business, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience working directly with trading clients. 
 Series 3 License required, or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire. 
 Pre-existing book of high-value prosumer or retail derivatives clients preferred.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Discoverability
jobs.location: Hybrid - San Francisco, New York City, Austin
jobs.excerpt:
About Vercel: 
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 Search is changing. Developers no longer just type queries into Google — they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude, and, increasingly, they don't ask at all: their coding agents do. When a developer prompts Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or v0 to build something, the framework, deployment target, and docs those agents reach for are decided before a human ever visits a website. This is existential for Vercel: we're the agentic infrastructure platform for the agent era, agents already trigger more than half of our deployments, and being the answer that both AI assistants *and* coding agents surface, cite, and build with is quickly becoming as important as ranking on page one. 
 We're hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own Discoverability end to end: how easily developers, teams, AI assistants, and coding agents find, understand, and choose Vercel across every surface where discovery happens. You'll own our organic footprint across traditional search (SEO) and answer engines (AEO/GEO) — where "answer engines" spans both conversational assistants and the coding agents developers build with — from the technical foundation that makes our content machine-readable to the content and structure that makes us the answer. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You'll set the discoverability strategy and execute it hands-on, partnering closely with Growth Product, Content, Web Engineering, and Developer Relations. You'll report to the Head of Growth and be a key driver of Vercel's product-led, self-serve growth engine. 
   
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Own Vercel's organic acquisition strategy across SEO and AEO/GEO, with clear goals for traffic, non-branded visibility, share of voice in AI answers, how often coding agents choose and recommend Vercel, and downstream signups.  
 Lead technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data (schema), Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, and internal linking — working directly in our stack and with Web Engineering to ship fixes. 
 Build our answer-engine strategy across both surfaces: (1) conversational assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google's AI surfaces, and (2) coding agents like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and v0. 
 Understand how each retrieves and cites content — including docs, llms.txt, structured data, and machine-readable references — and shape our surfaces so Vercel is the source they reference and the default they build with. 
 Partner with Content and PMM to build a scalable content and information architecture — programmatic pages, docs, comparison and solution pages, and editorial — that ranks and gets cited. 
 Define and own the measurement layer: instrument the funnel from organic and AI-referred discovery through to activation, choosing the tooling and building the dashboards that make discoverability performance legible to the wider company. 
 Run a continuous experimentation program (page structure, metadata, schema, content formats) and turn results into repeatable playbooks. 
 Own domain and technical health across our web properties in collaboration with Engineering — migrations, redirects, canonicalization, and international/localization structure. 
 Stay ahead of a fast-moving landscape and translate algorithm and AI-engine changes into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap. 
 
 About You: 
 
 6+ years in SEO, organic growth, or technical/growth marketing, with a track record of driving organic acquisition at scale — ideally for a product-led or self-serve business. 
 Genuinely technical: comfortable with structured data and schema, rendering and indexation, log-file and crawl analysis, and reading enough code to work directly in a CMS or codebase and spec fixes with engineers. 
 Familiarity with Next.js or modern frontend rendering is a strong plus. 
 Equally strong on the content and strategy side: you know how information architecture, page structure, and editorial quality drive both rankings and citations, and you can partner with writers and PMMs to make it happen. 
 Early, hands-on perspective on AEO/GEO across both conversational assistants and coding agents — you've experimented with how they retrieve, cite, and act on content (docs, llms.txt, structured references) and have opinions grounded in real tests, not just theory. 
 Fluent in the analytics stack (e.g., GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, BigQuery or similar) and able to define your own metrics, build dashboards, and defend priorities with data. 
 A self-starter who thrives with ambiguity and ownership, and can move between strategy and execution without waiting for direction 
 
 Bonus If You: 
 
 Experience marketing to developers or technical audiences is a strong plus. 
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $150,000 - $207,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. 
 We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $500K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. 
 If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. 
 We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator to join our San Francisco Office. This is a high-execution, broad-scope role for someone who is organized and ambitious, loves being in the room when things happen, and finds genuine satisfaction in making complex logistics look effortless. You’ll be responsible for field marketing, community, campaign execution, and light office coordination. This is a role for someone who wants to become a strong marketing operator: the kind of person who can take a clear direction and turn it into reliable, organized action. 
 Why This Role Exists 
 We've opened a San Francisco office to strengthen our presence in the Voice AI market by expanding our field marketing programs. Sponsoring (and building campaigns around) third-party events, crafting executive dinners and experiences, and hosting community meetups are core to how we build relationships and awareness in our market—and we've reached the point where we need additional execution support on the ground in SF to get even more programs off the ground. 
 This role is a force multiplier for the marketing team. It will free up capacity to run a higher volume of events, grow our local community presence, and add execution support across campaigns and operations. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Community & Meetup Support 
 
 Help coordinate local community meetups and lighter-weight activations in San Francisco  
 Own invite management, RSVP tracking, reminders, venue coordination, materials prep, and post-event follow-up  
 Support relationship-building with community members, local partners, creators, and attendees  
 Help make SF-based community motions more consistent and easier to run at volume 
 Be physically present at events to support setup, registration, and on-the-ground execution 
 
 Campaign & Marketing Operations Support 
 
 Support email campaign execution—including list coordination, QA, asset organization, and execution follow-through  
 Contribute to recurring campaign workflows that keep marketing programs running smoothly and consistently  
 Assist with campaign setup and tracking across event, lifecycle, community, and brand work  
 Learn marketing tools like Iterable (or similar) and contribute to process improvement over time 
 
 San Francisco Office Coordination (~10% of role) 
 
 Help get our SF office environment set up and running smoothly 
 Coordinate ongoing office needs—supplies, organization, vendor relationships, and light upkeep 
 Be the in-person connective tissue for our SF presence, especially during team visits and hosted events 
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 
 Work with field marketing, growth, lifecycle, community, and brand teammates to keep projects moving 
 Bring structure and follow-through to ambiguous situations—flag blockers, close loops, keep stakeholders informed 
 Operate comfortably in an environment where priorities move quickly and clear direction matters 
 
 Must-Have Qualifications 
 
 1–3 years of experience in a marketing, events, or operations role (internships and contract work count) 
 Strong organizational skills—you track tasks, details, and timelines without dropping things 
 Clear, confident written and verbal communication; you can coordinate across multiple stakeholders without friction 
 Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities 
 Based in San Francisco; comfortable being in-person regularly 
 Fluent with AI tools in your day-to-day work—you use them to work faster and smarter, not as a crutch 
 Proactive communicator who flags issues early and closes the loop without being asked 
 
 Nice-to-Have Qualifications 
 
 Experience supporting events, field marketing, or community programs 
 Familiarity with tools like Iterable, Luma, looker 
 Experience at a startup or high-growth tech company 
 Exposure to email marketing operations, campaign coordination, or lifecycle programs 
 Background in community coordination, developer events, or brand activations 
 Experience in AI/ML, voice tech, or developer-facing products (a genuine plus, not a requirement) 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 30 Days 
 
 You’ve met every marketer on the team and understand the portfolio of events, campaigns, and programs we run 
 You’ve taken ownership of at least one active event or logistics initiative and are driving it forward 
 You’re oriented in our key tools and have a clear read on where you can add the most immediate value 
 You’ve assessed the SF office situation and have a plan for any setup or coordination needs 
 You’ve started learning the details of our product marketing and positioning

 You’ve executed at least one SF-based event or meetup and gathered learnings for the next one 
 You’re contributing to campaign execution support and have started learning our email and lifecycle tools 
 
 90 Days 
 
 You’re a reliable, trusted operator for field marketing execution 
 You’ve identified at least one process gap and proposed an improvement 
 You’re building real relationships with vendors, venues, and community contacts in San Francisco

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines product judgment, excellent writing, and strong cross-functional leadership.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and Europe. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Develop positioning, messaging, and core narratives for feature releases, key launches, and strategic product narratives

 - Partner closely with Product management, Engineering, and Design to refine how products are presented across in-product and external surfaces

 - Create and coordinate launch deliverables such as changelogs, demos, enablement materials, email, social copy, and go-to-market communications

 - Equip Sales, CX, and other customer-facing teams with the context and materials they need to communicate new launches effectively

 - Bring customer insight, product understanding, and market context back into product and launch decisions

What we’re looking for

 - Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex ideas feel clear and compelling

 - Strong positioning and messaging skills grounded in customer problems, product truth, and differentiation

 - Great project management skills and ability to track large amounts of detail.

 - Comfort going deep on product details and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design

 - Strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Strategic Delivery
jobs.excerpt:
About SimpliSafe 
 We’re a high-tech home security company that’s passionate about protecting the life you’ve built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we’ve created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you’re building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don’t just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. We’re embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done. 
 Why are we hiring? 
 Well, we’re growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.  
 What you’ll do 
 In this role, you'll partner with Go-to-Market and Customer Experience business teams to capture and document business needs into clear, actionable requirements, then work with Operations and Growth Engineering teams to translate those requirements into scoped, executable work. You'll help drive the day-to-day management and refinement of JIRA projects and backlogs, and help track progress against quarterly priorities. Acting as a liaison between business and technical teams, you'll keep requirements accurate through delivery, analyze data and processes to identify efficiency opportunities, and maintain reporting that gives stakeholders clear visibility into progress and timelines. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Requirements & Analysis 
 
 Elicit, document, and translate business needs into clear, detailed requirements (user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria) that align teams on scope and value 
 Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and Product to support informed decisions, providing analysis on customer impact, technical feasibility, cost, and speed to market 
 Support end-to-end delivery of initiatives, from concept through launch and iteration, ensuring requirements remain accurate and actionable at every stage 
 Maintain and refine backlogs, support sprint planning, and assist prioritization using Agile methodologies in JIRA 
 Validate that delivered features and enhancements meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria across internal tools and platforms 
 
 Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication 
 
 Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, translating needs into clear, actionable requirements and process documentation 
 Support alignment across cross-functional partners (Engineering, Design, Marketing, CX, Enablement) by surfacing tradeoffs, dependencies, and impacts 
 
 What you'll bring 
 
 3-5 years of experience as a business analyst, project coordinator / manager, product owner or related roles 
 Utilization of AI tools to streamline process, build requirements documentation, and drive efficiencies 
 Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into clear and detailed requirements. 
 Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions 
 Proven ability to work across cross-functional teams and support delivery of complex initiatives 
 Experience working in Agile environments (Jira or similar tools) 
 Excellent communication, writing, and stakeholder management skills 
 Bachelor's Degree. A technical discipline (engineering or science) is a plus 
 
 What Values You’ll Share 
 
 Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them. 
 Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar. 
 No Ego - Maintaining a “no job too small” attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style. 
 One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success. 
 Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. 
 Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. 
 
 What We Offer 
 
 A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive   
 A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here ) 
 Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.  
 Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. 
 
 The target annual base pay range for this role is $107,900 to $143,800 
 This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees’ job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.  
 Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be  found here . 
 We’re committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values. 
 We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact  careers@simplisafe.com .

jobs.excerpt:
We're looking for a Social Content Manager to join the Owned and Influencer team at Whole Foods Market. This role focuses on developing and executing lifestyle-driven, long-form editorial content that positions Whole Foods Market as a lifestyle brand and cultural force — in close collaboration with our Brand Engagement, Creative, and Production teams. About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role: 
 Anthropic's GTM Systems team builds and operates the systems and processes behind the company's go-to-market motion — quoting, provisioning, customer success tooling, and the data infrastructure that ties them together. As a Program Manager on the team, you'll own cross-functional coordination across our concurrent systems initiatives: aligning stakeholders, running quarterly business reviews, and making sure every program stays tied to the business outcome it exists to drive. 
 You'll work across Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Business Technology leadership to keep multiple in-flight programs moving in lockstep — CPQ, deployment tracking, account data quality, and compliance-driven process change. You'll be the person in the room translating between technical implementation detail and executive priorities, and the person following up afterward to make sure alignment turns into action. 
 In a typical week, you'll prepare for and run quarterly business reviews, meet with operational leads and stakeholders across the GTM organization, and pull together the documentation that keeps initiatives aligned. Throughout, you'll dig into the "why" behind each program — not just tracking status, but making sure the team can always articulate the business outcome a program is meant to drive and how it's being measured. 
 Key responsibilities: 

 Own cross-functional coordination across concurrent GTM systems programs, including CPQ, deployment tracking, account data quality, and compliance-driven process change 

 Prepare and run quarterly business reviews for GTM systems initiatives, and drive the decisions and follow-ups that come out of them 

 Partner with operational leads and stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Business Technology to keep programs aligned and moving 

 Translate between technical implementation detail and executive priorities in both directions, so engineers understand the business context and leadership understands the trade-offs 

 Define and track the business outcome each program exists to drive, along with how it's measured, and hold programs to it 

 Aggregate and maintain the documentation, plans, and status views that keep cross-functional initiatives coherent 

 Surface risks, dependencies, and competing priorities early, and drive them to resolution without direct authority over the teams involved 

 Minimum qualifications: 

 Hands-on experience with GTM processes at a software or technology company — lead-to-cash, quote-to-cash, renewal and expansion motions, or customer health 

 Working understanding of how systems such as Salesforce, CPQ platforms, or customer success tools support those processes 

 A track record of owning cross-functional alignment with senior stakeholders — running recurring business reviews, facilitating rooms with competing priorities, and driving decisions without direct authority 

 Strong program management fundamentals: planning, tracking, dependency and risk management 

 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between technical detail and executive summary depending on the audience 

 Work effectively in fast-moving environments with high ambiguity, including where process doesn't exist yet 

 Excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial 

 Preferred qualifications: 

 Experience with lead and campaign automation, CPQ implementations, or customer success and health-scoring programs (Gainsight or equivalent) at a software company 

 Experience operating in a compliance-sensitive environment, such as SOX or IPO readiness 

 Experience partnering closely with engineering or business technology teams on systems implementations, not only with business stakeholders 

 Familiarity with the data models behind GTM systems, and comfort using data to diagnose whether a program is working 

 Experience at a company that scaled significantly during your tenure

Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.  How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

jobs.title: Associate Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done. We are seeking an Associate Product Marketing Manager to join our team and serve as the bridge between how our products actually work and how the world learns to use them. You will develop the deepest product understanding on the team and translate it into webinars and education materials that inspire adoption and drive growth.

If you have a passion for understanding how things work, thrive in taking something complex and making it simple, and want to build a world-class product education engine that turns new users into power users, this role is for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Know the product cold. Develop a deeper working knowledge of our products than anyone else in marketing, using every feature the day it ships, building the workflows yourself, and staying close to the teams that built them.

 - Turn complexity into clarity. Transform complex product capabilities into simple, specific, and accurate explanations, defining not just what we built, but how it works, when to use it, and why it matters.

 - Teach at scale. Own product webinars end to end, from content and live demos to delivery and follow-up, spanning onboarding series, feature deep-dives, and use-case walkthroughs.

 - Build the education engine. Create the product education materials our users learn from: how-to guides, demo flows, video walkthroughs, and use-case libraries that make customers materially better at their jobs.

 - Obsess over the user. Maintain a sharp, real-time view of what users misunderstand and where they get stuck, ensuring our education remains grounded in how people actually use the product rather than how we assume they do.

 - Measure outcomes, not just outputs. Tie webinars and education content to tangible activation, adoption, and retention, running lightweight experiments to iterate fast on format, content, and delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2-3 years of experience in product marketing, customer education, business development, or a related role, ideally within a high-growth technology company, or work that proves the skill regardless of title.

 - Proven ability to synthesize complex technical concepts into simple, specific, and provable explanations that travel across new users, power users, and admins.

 - Genuine obsession with product: you explore every setting, test every new feature, and can explain what a product does better than the team that built it.

 - Sharp teaching and storytelling skills grounded in data, with the ability to summarize how a feature works in a single sentence and demonstrate it live.

 - High slope: you learn unfamiliar products and domains fast, and your rate of improvement is your standout trait.

 - Extreme comfort delivering clarity in high-velocity, ambiguous environments.

 Manage the administration, configuration, and integration of  Salesforce.com  and other tools across the GTM tech stack, including technologies for marketing automation, sales engagement, data enrichment, analytics, etc. 
 Define and maintain the systems strategy and roadmap. 
 Recommend and drive process and system improvement initiatives across the end-to-end revenue organization.

 What You’ll Need: 
 
 Certified SFDC Administrator required with 3-5 years of relevant hands-on administration experience. 
 Experience with marketing automation and marketing analytics (such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, etc.).

jobs.excerpt:
Business Value Marketing Manager 
 Team: Marketing – Business Value Services · Reports to: Head of Business Value Services · Location: San Francisco 
 About Sigma 
 Sigma is the cloud analytics platform built directly on the data warehouse. Business teams use it to explore live data with the ease of a spreadsheet and to build interactive data apps on top of Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, with AI now doing a growing share of the work. We crossed $200M in ARR and raised an $80M Series E at a $3B valuation, and we are growing fast. 
 The role 
 This is value marketing , owned by Business Value Services: turning the outcomes customers have already realized into proof the go-to-market team uses to win and expand accounts. 
 As our Business Value Marketing Manager, you'll own how the value customers realize with Sigma becomes proof the whole go-to-market team can use. You'll build the system that tells us which customers are seeing results and why, then turn those outcomes into a steady supply of published proof and reference-ready advocates that sales and Business Value Services can pull from to win and expand accounts. 
 This is an individual-contributor role and an entry point into marketing at Sigma. 
 What you'll own 
 
 The value-proof engine Build and run the system that turns customer outcomes into published proof on a predictable cadence: case studies, videos, and quote cards grounded in real outcome data. This role turns customer outcomes into proof for prospects, the market, and the sales team. 
 Advocacy and references Grow a referenceable-customer bench relevant to our field sales teams, run the advocacy program, and feed Majors and ABM with proof tied to the value a customer has already realized. 
 Value stories at events Source and prepare customer speakers for our biggest annual events such as Snowflake Summit, Databricks DAIS, and our own Workflow conference. Own the Sigma User Meetups (SUMs) webinar series. 
 Reviews and recognition Drive review volume and quality on G2 and Gartner Peer Insights, and run programs like "Built with Sigma" awards that give customers a reason to put their name next to ours. 
 The Customer Advisory Board Own and mature Sigma’s CAB program in partnership with Business Value Services, and turn what you hear into both product input and pipeline. 
 Cross-Functional Distribution of Resources Bring relevant stories into the website, the sales plays, and the ABM pages. 
 The agentic stack Operate the AI-first system (Sigma, Claude, and the connected tooling) so drafting, repurposing, and distribution run at a volume one person plus agents can sustain, and improve that system as you go. 
 
 What you bring 
 
 Three to five years in B2B SaaS value marketing, customer advocacy, customer reference, customer success, BVS, or a closely related field. This is an entry point into marketing, so adjacent experience counts.   
 A track record of creating proof and references yourself, not only executing an existing playbook. 
 Strong writing and storytelling instinct, and the judgment to find the one outcome in a customer conversation that a prospect will actually care about. 
 Comfort with AI tooling. You have built, or are eager to build, agentic workflows, and you are not precious about doing by hand what an agent can do better. 
 Data fluency. You can work inside a warehouse-native analytics product, pull your own outcome numbers, and partner with RevOps without needing everything handed to you. 
 Event and customer-speaker exposure, and the diplomacy to manage customer relationships and executive stakeholders 
 A cross-functional operator who works across sales, Business Value Services, customer success, product marketing, and field marketing without friction. 
 
 Additional Job details 
 The base salary range for this position is $126 - 148k annually. 
 Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work at Sigma Computing. This role is eligible for stock options, as well as a comprehensive benefits package. About us:  
 Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.  
 Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year. 
 Come join us!

 Paid bonding time for all new parents

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Global Builder Lofts , Developer Experience
jobs.excerpt:
AWS Developer Experience is looking for a Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end marketing strategy and digital presence for the AWS Builder Loft program globally. Builder Lofts are physical developer community spaces where builders come together for hands-on workshops, hackathons, technical talks and networking. This role is critical for driving awareness and sustained audience growth through data-driven campaigns, compelling content, and seamless integration between physical touchpoints and digital engagement. This is a high-impact role that requires a marketer who combines strong storytelling with multi-channel marketing experience, thinks globally while executing locally, and understands developer communities. We're looking for someone who has the ability to build marketing playbooks, mechanisms, and scalable frameworks that allow a fast-growing global program to operate with consistency and efficiency. You leverage AI tools and automation to multiply your impact, move faster, and continuously improve marketing performance. You will work cross-functionally with PR, community, events, developer advocacy, and product teams across different geographies to build repeatable strategies and execution frameworks for a rapidly scaling global program. Key job responsibilities - Promotion Strategy: Develop and execute the Loft promotion strategy across AWS-owned and third-party email programs, social media, web, and grassroots channels to drive awareness, events registration/attendance and returning visitors - Registration & CRM Management: Manage event registration platforms and ensure seamless data flow to marketing CRMs, maintaining data integrity and enabling automated nurture workflows. - Content Calendar & Publishing: Own the content calendar for the Builder Loft content series showcasing Loft experiences, builder stories, and hands-on learning opportunities. Coordinate with team members and external partners to drive content creation and ensure editorial quality. - KPI Tracking & Reporting: Track and report on marketing KPIs including registration conversion rates, email open/click rates, social media engagement, content reach, and web monthly active users. - Audience Analysis: Conduct demographic and cohort analysis of Loft attendees to inform programming and outreach decisions. Own attendee data analysis, identifying trends in audience composition, repeat attendance, and engagement patterns. - PR Coordination: Coordinate with AWS PR teams high-profile event announcements, ensuring consistent messaging and maximum media impact. - Localization: Lead localization efforts where necessary, adapting marketing materials, campaigns, and content for local markets while maintaining brand consistency. - Physical-to-Digital Engagement Strategy Ownership: Designing the strategy that moves builders from initial awareness and in-person attendance into sustained always-on digital engagement. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the Community & Partnerships Manager on community channel promotion and co-marketing with partners. Work effectively across AWS with groups such as developer advocacy, digital marketing, field marketing, sales, and startup teams. A day in the life You start the morning working on a social media campaign highlighting the communities that the Builder Loft has been working with for the past year with the goal of acquiring new strategic partners who can host events in the space. You use an AI summarization tool to pull key information about previous campaign data, audience insights, industry trends, social media platform know-hows and feed them into the plan. Mid-morning, you join a cross-functional sync with the PR team to align on the messaging framework for an upcoming high profile Builder Loft event. After that, you're reviewing the content calendar, writing an article, and briefing your agency partner on assets needed for the next campaign sprint. In the afternoon, you're building a new campaign playbook, documenting the end-to-end process for a "city launch" so that when the next Builder Loft opens, there's a repeatable, high-quality execution plan ready to deploy. You close the day by organizing customer feedback you’ve seen online and compiling a collection of social media posts and other coverage, sending a Slack recap to your team members with synthesized insights and trends. 

Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience - Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion - Experience in designing and producing content for a technical audience, such as Software Engineers, System Administrators, or IT professionals - Experience analyzing digital marketing campaigns, patterns and data trends to determine if they are meeting business objectives, and in turn leading recommendations to optimize - - Experience managing event registration or marketing automation platforms (e.g., Cvent, Marketo, HubSpot, or similar).

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities - - Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to drive efficiency, personalization, and scale - - Familiarity with community-led growth strategies and grassroots marketing. - -Experience in event marketing - - Experience coordinating with PR teams on product launches or location openings. jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Amazon Music Experiences
jobs.excerpt: Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. The Amazon Music Experiences team is seeking a Campaigns Manager to own the full lifecycle of experiential campaigns sold to brand partners. This role sits at the intersection of sales enablement, brand partnerships, and campaign execution, owning both the pre-sale and post-sale experience for brands investing in Amazon Music's experiential portfolio. You will work directly with brands and agencies to sell, scope, and deliver world-class experiential activations that connect fans to music and culture in meaningful ways. As a Campaigns Manager, you will be responsible for building and managing relationships with brand partners and their agency teams, developing compelling experiential proposals, and ensuring flawless execution from signed IO to post-campaign wrap. You will serve as the primary point of contact for brand and agency stakeholders throughout the campaign lifecycle, translating client objectives into activations that deliver measurable results. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, can manage competing priorities across multiple live campaigns, and brings a customer-obsessed mindset to every interaction. You will travel approximately 40% of the time to be on-site at activations, client meetings, and industry events. Key job responsibilities Role Summary **Pre-Sale** - Develop and present experiential campaign proposals to brands and agencies, articulating the value of Amazon Music's experiential platform and partnership opportunities. - Build and maintain a pipeline of brand prospects, proactively identifying alignment between brand objectives and Amazon Music's experiential offerings. - Partner with internal sales teams to craft custom packages that meet brand KPIs while protecting the integrity of the fan experience. - Lead pitch meetings and RFP responses, tailoring narratives to brand and agency audiences. - Develop case studies and sell sheets that demonstrate ROI and creative impact of past activations. - Drive toward and exceed a personal sales goal of $2M+ annually through new business development and renewals. **Post-Sale** - Own end-to-end campaign management from contract execution through wrap report delivery, bringing each experience to life with precision and creative excellence. - Serve as the day-to-day brand and agency contact, managing expectations, timelines, and deliverables. - Coordinate cross-functionally with production, creative, legal, finance, artist teams, and marketing to deliver on campaign commitments. - Manage campaign budgets, ensuring accurate forecasting and reconciliation. - Develop and deliver post-campaign reporting that quantifies brand value, audience engagement, and earned media impact. - Identify upsell and renewal opportunities based on campaign performance and evolving brand needs. **Building Experiences and Fan Integration** - Collaborate with artist teams to ensure brand activations complement and enhance the artist vision, creating authentic moments that resonate with fans. - Design fan-first experiences that integrate brand messaging organically into the event environment, prioritizing fan engagement over passive exposure. - Work with internal stakeholders across Amazon Music programming, marketing, and product to align experiential activations with broader strategic priorities. - Champion the fan perspective in all campaign decisions, ensuring every touchpoint delivers value to the audience while meeting brand objectives. **Agency and Brand Relationship Management** - Build trusted advisor relationships with agency planners, buyers, and brand marketing leads, driven by a customer-obsessed approach to partnership. - Educate agency and brand partners on Amazon Music's experiential capabilities, audience insights, and emerging formats. - Navigate complex multi-stakeholder environments across holding companies, independent agencies, and direct-to-brand relationships. - Represent Amazon Music Experiences at industry events, client summits, and agency days. **Internal Stakeholder Management** - Manage cross-functional relationships with production, creative, legal, finance, artist relations, and programming teams to ensure seamless campaign delivery. - Proactively communicate campaign status, risks, and opportunities to leadership and partner teams. - Operate as the connective tissue between external client needs and internal operational capabilities, translating between both audiences fluently. About the team The Amazon Music Experiences team is a pioneering business unit within Amazon Music that operates at the intersection of music, culture, brand partnerships, and live fan engagement. We are an industry-first experiences marketplace, creating a new revenue category by connecting premium brands with fans through immersive, culturally resonant activations tied to Amazon Music's artist programming and tentpole moments. Our team builds, sells, and executes experiential campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising. We design physical and hybrid activations where brands show up authentically alongside artists and fans, creating moments that drive emotional connection, cultural relevance, and measurable business outcomes for our partners. What We Do We own the full lifecycle of experiential brand partnerships, from concept creation through sales through on-the-ground execution and post-campaign measurement. Our work spans: - **Artist-Led Activations**: Partnering with artist teams to build branded experiences that complement and amplify the artist's creative vision while delivering value for brand partners. Our portfolio includes landmark executions such as Kendrick Lamar's Pop Out Experience, Bad Bunny's Residency Experience, De La Soul's DAISY Experience, and the Amazon Music 50 and Forever campaign celebrating 50 years of HipHop. - **Live Programming Integration**: Creating brand experiences within Amazon Music Live programming, including the Thursday Night Football television series, where brands engage fans in real-time cultural moments. - **Fan-First Experience Design**: Every activation we build starts with the fan. We design experiences where brand presence enhances the moment rather than interrupting it, ensuring fans walk away with a memory, not a media impression. - **Experiences Marketplace**: We have architected a scalable business model that packages Amazon Music's cultural access, artist relationships, and fan touchpoints into a marketplace where brands can invest in experiences across a range of formats, budgets, and objectives. How We Work We operate as a cross-functional team embedded within Amazon Music's Global Creative Organization (GCO), partnering closely with artist relations, programming, marketing, production, legal, and finance. Externally, we work directly with brands and their agency partners to develop custom experiential solutions. Our team thrives in ambiguity.
